name: The rooftop reservoir
subtitle: Restore two pumps, then bring the rooftop back to life.
hint: Phase A: record Right ×2, Up ×2. Replay Right ×4, Up, Right ×2, Down, Right, then activate pump A. Phase B: record Right ×2, Up ×5. Replay Up ×4, Right ×6, Down, then activate pump B. Phase C: record Up ×3. Replay Right, Up ×2, Right ×3, Up, then activate the final terminal.
